issue.title: ESQL: null layout on ECS schema with WHERE + STATS

labels.name: Team:QL (Deprecated)
labels.description: Meta label for query languages team

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Using an [ECS dataset](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/ecs/current/ecs-file.html), a query like

```
from logs* 
| where user.name is not null
| stats filecount = min(file.size) by host.name
```

in some cases fails with NullPointerExcaption

![image (2)](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/assets/459289/1641a6dc-5fff-4ada-b24b-ee0969403741)

issue.title: QL: Preserve subfields for invalid types

labels.name: Team:QL (Deprecated)
labels.description: Meta label for query languages team

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
In certain scenarios, a field can be mapped both as a primitive and
 object, causing it to be marked as unsupported, losing any potential
 subfields that might have been discovered before.
This commit preserve them to avoid subfields from being incorrectly
 reported as missing.

Fix #100869

body:
> listing the field as missing instead of say unsupported is incorrect

This should only be valid for ESQL. SQL hides these fields.
There's also the use case of `show columns` where these fields should be displayed.
